up: Retrieve up to 1000 activity data rows for the human single-protein target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1892 and preferred name 'Glutamate carboxypeptidase 2' (target type 'SINGLE PROTEIN', organism Homo sapiens). Only include IC50 measurements (standard_type = 'IC50') with exact standard relation '=' and non-null pChEMBL values. For each such activity row, return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order the result rows first by molecule ChEMBL ID, then by assay ChEMBL ID, and limit to the first 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS "assay ChEMBL ID", t.target_type AS "target type", t.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles AS "canonical SMILES", md.chembl_id AS "molecule ChEMBL ID", a.standard_type AS "standard type", a.pchembl_value AS "pChEMBL value" FROM target_dictionary t JOIN assays ass ON t.tid = ass.tid JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE t.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1892' AND t.pref_name = 'Glutamate carboxypeptidase 2' AND t.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND t.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000;
